newsitem.title: USA: CKE raises stake in Rally's.
newsitem.headline: CKE raises stake in Rally's.

text.p: CKE Restaurants Inc Friday said it had exercised 587,607 options to purchase common stock of Rally's Hamburgers Inc from Giant Group Ltd at $3 per share.
CKE said it now owns about 18 percent of Rally's.
CKE originally purchased about 2.3 million shares of Rally's from Giant Group at $1.75 per share pursuant to an April 26 agreement.
CKE has options to purchase an additional 587,607 shares of Rally's at $4 per share under this agreement.
Through a recent Rally's rights offering, CKE also has 775,488 warrants to purchase Rally's common stock at $2.25 per share.
CKE has been operating 27 company-owned Rally's locations in California and Arizona since July.
